coverage_notes.source_review: Twelve bounded targeted searches surfaced no newly substantiated nonduplicate U.S./territory healthcare-access change in this window. Results were predominantly older U.S. closures, international incidents, proposals, or background articles. CMS official listing had no new entry. No finding meets evidence and novelty thresholds.
